title: Benchmark machine profile
responsibility: Captures machine and runtime facts and derives a repeatable profile identity for measurement comparison.

outputs.name: machineProfile
outputs.description: Profile with platform, architecture, CPU model, logical core count, total memory and Bun/Node version, plus a 16-character SHA-256-derived id. A nonblank HARNESS_PROFILE_LABEL is included in the runtime label and therefore the identity.
